desc: Read N, K, and array A from stdin.
Precompute binomial coefficients C(K, j) for j=0..K modulo MOD = 998244353.
Compute prefix sums P_0..P_N modulo MOD (with P_0 = 0).
Initialize array S[0..K] = 0, representing sums of P_l^e for l < current r.
Compute P_pow[0..K] where P_pow[e] = P_r^e mod MOD (via repeated multiplication).
For each j in 0..K: term = C(K,j) * (-1)^(K-j) % MOD * P_pow[j] % MOD * S[K-j] % MOD; add to answer.
Update S[e] = (S[e] + P_pow[e]) % MOD for e=0..K.
If r < N: P = (P + A[r]) % MOD (advance to next prefix).
After loop, print answer modulo MOD.
